# TESCA Spoken English & Visa Consultancy — Full Institutional Knowledge Base

## Overview
TESCA (Technical & Educational Services Consultancy Academy) is Gujarat's premier institute for English language learning, international examination coaching (IELTS, PTE), and overseas education consulting. Founded in 2005 in Surat, India, TESCA has trained over 5,000 students and professionals with a certified 95% proficiency achievement rate.

- **Founding Year:** 2005
- **Official Website:** https://tesca.co
- **Central Helpline:** +91 84888 05888
- **Support & Admissions:** +91 99250 60609
- **Email:** tescavisaconsultancy87@gmail.com
- **Locations:** Surat, Gujarat, India (4 Campuses) and Worldwide Online
- **Accreditations & Faculty:** Cambridge-certified master trainers (CELTA, DELTA, TESOL certified) with 10 to 18+ years of pedagogical experience.

## Course Curricula & Details

### 1. Spoken English Basic
- **Target Audience:** Absolute beginners, students from regional mediums (Gujarati/Hindi), homemakers, and professionals struggling with stage fear and sentence construction.
- **Duration:** 3 Months
- **Fee:** ₹7,999 (Discounted from ₹11,999)
- **Syllabus & Modules:**
  - Fundamental English Grammar: Tenses, parts of speech, prepositions, modals, active & passive voice.
  - Core Vocabulary: 500+ daily conversational phrases, collocations, idiomatic expressions.
  - Pronunciation & Phonics: Syllable stress, vowel sounds, mother tongue influence (MTI) neutralization.
  - Conversational Frameworks: Self-introductions, ordering food, retail shopping, telephone etiquette, asking directions.
  - Guided Speaking Labs: 1-on-1 speaking practice with instant corrective feedback.

### 2. Spoken English Advanced
- **Target Audience:** Working professionals, managers, entrepreneurs, and graduates seeking executive communication fluency.
- **Duration:** 4 Months
- **Fee:** ₹12,999 (Discounted from ₹17,999)
- **Syllabus & Modules:**
  - Corporate & Business English: Email writing, corporate jargon, meeting negotiation tactics.
  - Public Speaking & Presentation Skills: Impromptu speeches (JAM sessions), presentations, debate rounds.
  - Fluency & Thought Structuring: Overcoming translation delay, filler-free speaking, narrative storytelling.
  - Accent Neutralization: Global business accent, cadence, intonation patterns.

### 3. IELTS Preparation (Academic & General)
- **Target Audience:** Students pursuing overseas degrees and professionals seeking Canada/Australia PR.
- **Duration:** 6 Weeks (Fast-track and regular options available)
- **Fee:** ₹9,999 (Discounted from ₹14,999)
- **Syllabus & Modules:**
  - Listening: Audio decoding, multiple accents (British, Australian, North American), map labeling, MCQ strategies.
  - Reading: Skimming and scanning methods, True/False/Not Given mastery, time management (60 mins, 40 questions).
  - Writing: Task 1 (Report/Letter) structuring, Task 2 (Essay) thesis statements, lexical resource, cohesion & coherence.
  - Speaking: Part 1 interview, Part 2 Cue Card storytelling (2 mins uninterrupted), Part 3 abstract discussion.
  - Testing: 15+ full-length authentic mock exams with band score diagnostic reports.

### 4. PTE Academic Preparation
- **Target Audience:** Test takers seeking AI-scored computer-based English proficiency for university and visa processing.
- **Duration:** 5 Weeks
- **Fee:** ₹8,999 (Discounted from ₹12,999)
- **Syllabus & Modules:**
  - Speaking & Writing: Read Aloud pronunciation benchmarks, Repeat Sentence techniques, Describe Image templates, Retell Lecture outlines, Write Essay formats.
  - Reading: Fill in the Blanks (Reading & Writing), Re-order Paragraphs.
  - Listening: Summarize Spoken Text, Write From Dictation high-frequency question banks.
  - Testing: Lab mock tests evaluated with PTE AI scoring algorithms.

### 5. Interview Preparation
- **Target Audience:** College freshers, job seekers, and candidates preparing for corporate HR rounds or visa embassy interviews.
- **Duration:** 4 Weeks
- **Fee:** ₹5,999 (Discounted from ₹8,999)
- **Syllabus & Modules:**
  - Behavioral Interview Coaching: The STAR technique (Situation, Task, Action, Result).
  - Resume & LinkedIn Optimization: ATS-friendly resume formatting, professional elevator pitches.
  - Mock Interviews: Video recorded simulations with multi-point performance evaluations.

---

## Study Abroad Consulting & Visa Guidance
TESCA operates a specialized Study Abroad Visa wing assisting students from profile evaluation to pre-departure briefing.
- **Countries Handled:** United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, United States, Germany, France, and European Schengen states.
- **Success Rate:** 97% Visa approval track record.
- **Scope of Assistance:** University and college shortlisting, Statement of Purpose (SOP) drafting, Letter of Recommendation (LOR) guidance, financial affidavit preparation, and embassy mock interviews.

---

## Admissions & Free Demo Process
1. Prospective students can book a **Free 45-Minute Live Demo Class** online at https://tesca.co or via WhatsApp at +91 84888 05888.
2. A free initial CEFR language level diagnostic is conducted online or at the nearest campus.
3. Students are placed into matched peer batches based on current fluency level (Beginner, Intermediate, or Advanced).
4. Both morning (7:00 AM – 11:00 AM) and evening (5:00 PM – 8:30 PM) timings are offered.
